name: pi-legion
description: Herdr-backed subagents for Pi: visible, steerable, resumable child agents in Herdr panes

scripts.test: env -u PI_SUBAGENT_ALLOW_NESTED -u PI_SUBAGENT_CHILD -u PI_SUBAGENT_UTILITY_CHILD -u PI_SUBAGENT_MAX_DEPTH -u PI_SUBAGENT_PARENT_PATH -u PI_LEGION_DB -u PI_LEGION_NODE_ID node --experimental-strip-types --test test/unit/*.test.ts
scripts.test:integration: env -u PI_SUBAGENT_ALLOW_NESTED -u PI_SUBAGENT_CHILD -u PI_SUBAGENT_UTILITY_CHILD -u PI_SUBAGENT_MAX_DEPTH -u PI_SUBAGENT_PARENT_PATH -u PI_LEGION_DB -u PI_LEGION_NODE_ID node --experimental-strip-types --test test/integration/*.test.ts
scripts.test:live: env -u PI_SUBAGENT_ALLOW_NESTED -u PI_SUBAGENT_CHILD -u PI_SUBAGENT_UTILITY_CHILD -u PI_SUBAGENT_MAX_DEPTH -u PI_SUBAGENT_PARENT_PATH -u PI_LEGION_DB -u PI_LEGION_NODE_ID node --experimental-strip-types --test test/live/*.test.ts
scripts.test:all: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run test:integration

scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run test:integration
